report_identity.report_title: Annual Report 2023 Shineroad International Holdings Limited

business_overview.one_sentence: The group distributes food ingredients and food additives in Asia with R&D support and customer co-development.
business_overview.revenue_model: Goods are recognised at point in time upon delivery; payment is generally due within 30 to 90 days, with advance payment normally required for new customers.
business_notes: Revenue fell 6.14% to RMB683.591 million in 2023.
Profit for the year fell 57.44% to RMB20.257 million.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Three-year operating cash flow is uneven: 2021 was negative, 2022 strong because receivables fell, and 2023 positive before a large PPE/construction cash outflow. A conservative distributable cash profit must haircut the accounting profit base.

evidence.business_substance: Company IR annual report PDF stored in run work directory

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by legal entity or parent/subsidiary, so cash detachability uses a conservative PRC-subsidiary/group-level haircut.

The annual report does not identify maintenance versus growth capital expenditure; 2023 PPE purchase appears linked to construction in progress, so maintenance capex is estimated conservatively rather than mechanically using total PPE purchase.
No current market quote was used; market cap follows the input rough_screen_row historical signal dated 2024-05-20.
